messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service=redwood-inference-routing severity=P1 region=eu instance-pool=dedicated-eu — tail 5xx spike, error rate 27% (alert id: ALRT-99832)

emma (sre): acked. i'm on it, looking at grease & autoscaler. first check: is this a routing rule flapping?

raj (eng-oncall): i'm pulling routing logs now. seeing a surge of 502s from the canary routing rule (route: /v1/generate -> model-variant: rdx-7b-quant). could be upstream qps blowout.

emma (sre): good catch. downgrading canary to fallback model for EU: toggling flag `route.canary.enabled=false` in prod-config. doing now.

lia (prod-ops): heads up — toggling flag will move traffic to `model-variant: rdx-7b-quant-stable` which is on dedicated-eu pool. that pool has some spare capacity but autoscaler might be slow. prepping scale up.

pagerbot: action logged: `flag:set route.canary.enabled false` by emma (sre) (ts=1759812380)

emma (sre): running quick checks: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/router --tail=200 | grep 502 | wc -l` — seeing about 420 502s in last 2m.

raj (eng-oncall): launching immediate scale: `./infra-tools scale --pool dedicated-eu --replicas +3 --reason "P1 routing fallback"` (monitoring).

drew (support): customer-facing note: several customers reported generation timeout errors, primarily EU tenants on hosted api. estimated impacted sessions ~ 3.4k in last 5m. i'm drafting a short status update for support channels.

lia (prod-ops): saw spike correlating with a traffic burst from partner X — they pushed a background job around 12:09. might be correlated. notifying partner contact.

emma (sre): can someone run a KV cache check? if cache eviction storm, prefix cache miss can amplify upstream. `curl -s http://metrics/internal/kvcache | jq .evictions` -> evictions spiked. looks like evictions jumped 4x.

raj (eng-oncall): ok, autoscale kicked and added 3 nodes. tailing router logs — 502s dropping to ~80 in last 60s. still some error-requests tied to a specific client ip range. adding temporary rate-limit to that range via WAF: `wafctl rate-limit add 203.0.113.0/24 100r/m`

emma (sre): applying WAF block now. also enabling prefix/KV warmup on the new nodes to reduce cold misses: `infra run warmup --pool dedicated-eu --key-prefix /v1/generate`

pagerbot: note: `wafctl rate-limit` executed by raj (eng-oncall) (ts=1759812485)

drew (support): status update for customers: "We detected elevated errors for generation requests in EU; we've rerouted traffic to a stable model variant and are scaling the dedicated pool. Mitigation in progress. No data exposure. ETA 10-20 minutes." posting to status.redwood.ai now.

lia (prod-ops): partner X confirms they started a big batch job — asked them to back off for 15m. they acknowledged.

emma (sre): monitoring: 5xx rate down to 3.2%, latency median back to normal. still watching. recommend we keep flag off and keep autoscale buffer for 30m.

raj (eng-oncall): quickhand: i can take the follow-up ownership for the next 45m to watch for regressions. emma — want to do a handoff, or stay as primary?

emma (sre): passing to you, raj. i'll stay available for rollback/patch PRs. handing off now. raj is primary. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: pagerduty note: acknowledged by emma (sre) -> reassigned to raj (eng-oncall) (ts=1759812540)

drew (support): posted status update and updated ticket INC-2442 with mitigation steps and partner contact. customers are being notified via email digest.

raj (eng-oncall): will keep 1-minute pings. current metrics: error-rate 2.9%, p95 latency +15% but within SLO. continuing to monitor autoscaler and KV warmup heatmap.

lia (prod-ops): scheduling a follow-up postmortem meeting — propose 30m after we hit stable for 15m. sending calendar invite.

emma (sre): quick notes for postmortem: investigate prefix cache TTL, increase warmup on new node join, consider per-partner burst protection for partner X patterns.

raj (eng-oncall): ownership note: I'll annotate timeline and actions in the incident doc (link: https://docs.internal/incident/INC-2442). leaving channel but will watch alerts. ping me if we see >5% 5xx again.

pagerbot: incident resolved (severity downgraded to P2) by raj (eng-oncall) — final: route fallback + autoscale + WAF rate-limit mitigated the spike; customer errors dropping to baseline (ts=1759812645)

emma (sre): thanks team. good quick ops.

drew (support): closing the immediate customer alert; support will follow up with impacted customers tomorrow with root cause summary. :pray:
